description: Imani must decide whether to accept Noah for a summer room-share and set the final rent, occupancy, chore, quiet-hour, and guest terms after a scheduled household meeting with Noah and Celeste.

shared_context.S1: Imani's furnished spare bedroom is available for an informal summer room-share from June 1 through August 31.
shared_context.S2: The room includes a bed, desk, and access to the shared kitchen and bathroom.
shared_context.S3: Imani makes the final call on whether to arrange the room-share and sets the verbal terms.
shared_context.S4: The household's normal pre-move-in check-in gives the prospective tenant one turn to state the exact offer and gives the current housemate one turn to state exact household requirements.
shared_context.S5: After both statements, Imani reads back the proposed rent, occupancy, chore, quiet-hour, and guest terms, records which statements support them, and makes the final decision at that meeting.

PF1.text: Noah's exact offer is $480 per month, Monday-Friday nights only, with Noah cleaning the shared bathroom exactly once per week as part of the deal.

PF2.text: Celeste works overnight shifts and requires quiet from exactly 22:00 to 07:00 every night; she will agree to the room-share only if overnight guests are prohibited.

acceptance_conditions: The room-share must be accepted with Noah selected.
The monthly rent must be exactly $480.
Occupancy must be Monday-Friday nights only.
Noah must clean the shared bathroom exactly once per week.
A bathroom-cleaning commitment targeting Noah must be recorded.
Quiet hours must begin at exactly 22:00 and end at exactly 07:00.
Overnight guests must not be allowed.
Celeste's household requirement must be stated aloud and cited in the final settlement.

content_checks.C3: decisions['occupancy_pattern'] in ['Monday-Friday nights only', 'Monday through Friday nights only', 'Weeknights only, Monday through Friday']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'bathroom_cleaning' and c['target'] == 'Noah' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Noah's exact offer changes the selected tenant to Noah, sets rent at 480, sets Monday-Friday occupancy, sets bathroom cleaning at 1 per week, and adds a bathroom-cleaning commitment targeting Noah.
Celeste's exact household requirement changes the quiet-hour fields to 22 and 7, changes overnight guests to false, and supplies the private statement that must be revealed and cited.
